title: The Quiet Alibi
author: Vesper Eastwick
blurb: Bram Eriksen, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
